lead_tails.bound_basis: full sourced lead length below the seating plane (nominal + tolerance): the board-thickness tolerance is not sourced, and with the part seated flush or proud the protrusion cannot exceed this for any board thickness
lead_tails.lateral_clearance: the lead lies inside its window member (pad box + 0.3 mm); the assembly check measures it

lead_tails.bound_basis: full sourced lead length below the seating plane (nominal + tolerance): the board-thickness tolerance is not sourced, and with the part seated flush or proud the protrusion cannot exceed this for any board thickness
lead_tails.lateral_clearance: the lead lies inside its window member (pad box + 0.3 mm); the assembly check measures it

b_side_relief.solder_envelope: not needed for clearance: every B-face feature lies in a window through the 5 mm carrier, and every through-hole lead, taken at its full sourced length below the seating plane, ends inside its carrier window

keying.method: B-face features stand proud of the B face: PJ-324M terminals (nominal 1.6 mm, MANUFACTURER_MIRROR) and the soldered R0603 terminations (body up to 0.55 mm, SOURCE_DERIVED). In the correct pose all of them fall into carrier windows; turned 180 degrees in plane, the listed centres land on solid carrier, hold the board off the land and the datum pins, and the probes miss the test pads. Face-down insertion is excluded by the F-side jacks.
keying.acceptance_requirement: trial-insert the board turned 180 degrees: it must not seat (visible gap at the datum pins)

support.method: grid 0.1 mm over the board outline inside the carrier (board X 0-16.2, Y 13.0-62.9)
support.load_path: stops -> pressure plate -> spring plungers (POM pins) on the F face beside the probe field; the probe forces and the plunger loads go through the board to the carrier land around the windows -> spacers -> probe plate -> standoffs -> base
support.scope: rigid-body statics, a conservative beam estimate for the board across each unsupported chord and for the pressure plate between the stops (below)

holddown.type: rigid 6 mm FR-4 pressure plate screwed down onto two M3 hex standoffs (6 mm hard stops) on the carrier; 2 spring plungers with POM thrust pins, threaded into the plate, press the free F-face area beside the probe field
holddown.control: displacement: each plunger compression is fixed by the stop height, the board thickness and the plunger setting, so each plunger force lies in its own band independently of the others; there is no spring balance
holddown.plunger_force_basis: linear between the catalogue F1 and F2 over the stroke, +/-20 % acceptance band

board_bending_across_window.model: simply supported strip, point load at mid-span: d = F L^3 / (48 E I), I = b t^3 / 12; span = longest axis-parallel unsupported chord (no carrier land under the board) through the load point
board_bending_across_window.board_thickness_basis: PROJECT-CHOICE fabrication requirement 1.6 +/-0.16 mm (+/-10 %); not sourced, the fabricator is not selected. Bending uses the minimum thickness
board_bending_across_window.flexural_modulus_class: ASSUMED for the board: its laminate is not sourced (fabricator not selected). The sourced values below are typical values of other FR-4 class laminates, given for comparison; they do not bound the board laminate

representative_sourced_moduli.locator: physical page index 1, Young's Modulus B

representative_sourced_moduli.material: Von Roll Vetronite EGS 619 (EP GC 202, NEMA FR-4)

board_bending_across_window.limit_basis: PROJECT-CHOICE: small against the 2.05 mm between the 4.3 mm working stroke and the 6.35 mm maximum

holddown.statics: board: plunger loads minus the probe load leave a net downward load whose point lies inside the convex hull of the carrier land under the board for every plunger-force extreme and both probe-force extremes, so the board stays on the land (rigid bodies); plate: held by two seated screws on the stop faces, which carry the plunger reaction and its moment about the stop line

plunger_candidate.description: spring plunger with hexagon socket and POM thrust pin, steel sleeve, standard spring force
plunger_candidate.force_class: SOURCE_DERIVED: catalogue values printed as approx., no tolerance

source.locator: KIPP K0318 leaf, table "standard spring force", row K0318.04: D M4, D1 1,5, H 1,5, L 15, F1 initial pressure approx. 5 N, F2 final pressure approx. 16 N; thrust pin POM, sleeve steel 5.8

holddown.plunger_acceptance: each plunger: force at 0.99 mm compression within +/-20 % of the catalogue line; free pin tip set 5.39 +/-0.1 mm below the plate underside with a gauge before each session (the plunger has no thread lock)
holddown.plate_stack_acceptance: stop standoff length 6.0 +/-0.05 mm, measured before assembly; parts outside are not used
holddown.operation: remove the two M3 x 8 screws on the stop tops and lift the plate off with its plungers; insert the board and push it against X1, X2 and Y1; refit the plate and screw down until both screw heads seat (the plate bears on the stops). The plunger compression, not the screw torque, sets the hold-down force

registration.datums: board pushed by hand against X1, X2 (x = 16.2 edge) and Y1 (y = 62.9 edge) before the pressure plate is screwed down; friction under the contacts then holds it. Datum contact clearance zero is an acceptance check, not a spring
registration.plate_alignment: two 2 mm dowels (D1, D2) through carrier and probe plate align the bores to the datum pins; the M3 fasteners only clamp
registration.allocation_class: PROJECT-CHOICE, each closed by the acceptance measurement below
acceptance_requirements: each board: TP1-TP5 pad centres measured from the x = 16.2 and y = 62.9 edges; radial deviation from the design position <= 0.10 mm, else the board is not tested in this fixture

assembled carrier and probe plate: bore centres measured through the probe window from the datum pin contact lines; radial deviation <= 0.05 mm; bores 0.98-1.00 mm; windows and walls as drawn, walls not below 1.0 mm
installed probes: tip lateral offset from the bore axis at the working stroke <= 0.07 mm
clamped board: a 0.02 mm feeler does not enter between the board edge and X1, X2 or Y1

stroke.travel_stop: the board B face seats on the solid carrier land, which is independent of the receptacle press depth
stroke.set_installation_height: receptacle press ring pressed 0.7 mm into the probe-plate bore so the free probe tip stands 4.3 mm above the carrier top
stroke.acceptance_requirement: each probe: free tip height above the carrier top 4.3 +/-0.3 mm (stroke 4.0-4.6 mm, inside 0-6.35 mm)
stroke.force_basis: linear INGUN force-stroke graph (0.44 N preload, 1.0 N at 4.3 mm)

wiring.basis: 10 x the 0.55 mm Tefzel wire outer diameter (PROJECT-CHOICE bend allowance)
wiring.retention: the five prewired leads leave the receptacle tails, are sleeved with TP1-TP5 labels and tied through the base-plate slot (cable tie); no solder joint on the receptacle (INGUN note: crimp points must not be soldered)

insulation.plates: support carrier, probe plate, pressure plate and base plate are FR-4 (insulating)
insulation.board_contacts: POM thrust pins of the plungers on the F face; the steel plunger sleeves end at least 0.2 mm above the F face and clear every F-side courtyard; datum pins touch only the board edge

metal_to_probe_min_gap_mm.scope: in plan, metal under or beside the board (fasteners, stops, datum pins, dowels)

plunger_sleeves_to_probes.side: F, above the board; the probes are on the B side
plunger_sleeves_to_probes.basis: thinnest board plus the smallest sleeve-end gap above the F face; the assembly record gives the 3D distance

transform.description: Board coordinates for every part: x, y as on the PCB, z up from the board B face (carrier top). The B-view carrier coordinates in b_side_relief are x_c = 16.2 - x_board.

calculations.registration_equation: 0.25 - (board edge-to-pad + datum registration + bore position + probe lateral play/concentricity); all terms radial worst-case mm, each allocation closed by an acceptance measurement (b_side_relief.registration)

drilled_bore_web_mm.note: drilled at the fixed board test-point pitch (1.4 mm); meets the INGUN grid, needs fabricator confirmation

registration_tolerance_mm.note: tighter than standard; needs an annotated 2D drawing, availability not confirmed

owner_and_supplier_items: Fabricator for the four FR-4 plates is an owner choice and not selected; JLCCNC guidance is a candidate reference only. The probe-plate bores are drilled at the board test-point pitch, leaving 0.4 mm between bores: this meets the INGUN receptacle grid (0.27 mm) but not the 1.0 mm milled-wall guidance, so the chosen fabricator must confirm drilling it; the board pitch is fixed.
Registration needs the bore positions within 0.05 mm of the datum pins, tighter than the +/-0.1 mm standard tolerance: an annotated 2D drawing is needed.
Plate stock and every hardware line have one sourced candidate in hardware_proposal, awaiting owner approval; none is selected, and no price, stock or lead time was retrieved.
Receptacle drawing diameter 0.96 mm versus PDF table 0.95 mm; the bore follows the 0.98-1.00 mm FR-4 mounting-hole data, resolve before selection.
physical_items: No physical fit, contact, insertion-force or measured stroke evidence; no prototype exists; every acceptance measurement in b_side_relief is a requirement, not a result.

The hold-down plunger forces are catalogue approximations without a tolerance: the design takes them +/-20 % and each plunger must be measured against that band before use; the plunger has no thread lock, so its pin-tip setting is gauged before each session.
